title: Elavon expands All-In-One payments platform across North America to power integrated commerce
summary: Built with strategic technology partners to help businesses move faster in-store, on mobile and online Elavon, a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank (NYSE: USB) and a global payments provider, announced the expansion of its All-In-One payments platform across North America to help businesses deliver more seamless commerce experiences in-store, on mobile and online. The expanded platform combines Elavon’s payments infrastructure with a growing ecosystem of technology partners, giving merchants a more unified way to manage payments and operations while improving customer and guest experiences. “As commerce evolves, businesses need more than a payment processor.
